source_notes: Korean People's Army, epochs 1-7 (docs/05 boundaries). Compiled from recalled open-source references (IISS Military Balance patterns, standard Soviet-type specifications, parade imagery analysis) with NO web access; every uncertain figure is listed in estimated_fields and confidence is graded per entry. The faction freezes at epochs 3-4 by design (docs/08): the last major imports are the 1984-88 Soviet package (MiG-23ML, MiG-29, Su-25K, S-125, S-200, Mi-24D). After that, only artillery, MRLs, missiles, submarines and a thin parade layer advance. Absences are recorded as explicit nulls with reasons — the KPA has no multirole fighters, no SEAD, no AEW&C, no tankers, no MPA, no SSNs, and (until 2025) no destroyers. Where a system is shared with another faction (T-55/Type 59, BM-21 pattern, Romeo/Type 033 with cn) the baseline Soviet figures are used so cross-faction numbers match. Ship entries: mass_t = displacement, height = draft, speed_kmh converted from knots, road_range_km = endurance range. Aircraft: mass_t = MTOW, width = span/rotor diameter. M2020-generation parade systems (MBT, Pantsir-style SPAAGM, Pon'gae-5) are carried at low confidence: existence is certain, capability is a claim.
